listing.name: Chrono Trigger (Nintendo DS) — Egg of Time
listing.summary: Build a native Chrono Trigger player from your own Nintendo DS cartridge dump using Egg of Time.
listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are paused while the first-start build tools and recovery are being reviewed. The guide covers a copy you already trust and are permitted to use.

steps.title: Choose your original Nintendo DS game
steps.instruction: Use an unmodified .nds dump from your own cartridge. The accepted SHA-1 values are USA (YQUE) 11f9e8204e484eab42181b210c9f214584be75bf, Europe (YQUP) a6c69d789a6f2e31b27fba950423bea3c2f30a37, and Japan (YQUJ) afc91a3f1f6c1bd02845b76416239e4dabfae19f.

steps.title: Start the Windows x64 package
steps.instruction: Use a trusted EggOfTime Windows x64 ZIP ending in -windows-x64.zip. Extract it into a writable folder and open Egg of Time.exe. The package includes the tools for the local first-start build.

steps.title: Start the Linux x64 package
steps.instruction: The current Linux x64 packages need glibc 2.35 or newer, Python 3 and libcurl. They include Zig for the first-start build. The file picker uses xdg-desktop-portal or zenity. Extract the -linux-x64.tar.gz package and start Egg of Time from its folder, or make the separate x86-64 AppImage executable and open it.

steps.title: Let Egg of Time build your game
steps.instruction: Choose the .nds file when asked and wait for the local build to finish. The launcher copies the original to rom/CT.nds. If the build fails, open game/build.log in the same data location.

warnings: Use these steps with a copy you already trust and are permitted to use. Follow your operating system’s security prompts.
Keep your ROM, extracted assets, generated game code and saves private. Close Egg of Time and wait for any build to finish before replacing the package or copying its data.
The upstream macOS runtime compiles from source. Upstream lists a full Mac game build as untested.

references.title: Find the data for your package
references.instruction: For the Windows ZIP and Linux tarball, data stays beside the player. For the AppImage, keep EggOfTime under XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share/EggOfTime by default. Back up rom/CT.sav, rom/CT.state, eggoftime.ini, controls.ini and your mods before an update or a ROM region change.

references.title: Find the experimental Mac source instructions
references.instruction: Use Building from source in the upstream guide. It lists CMake 3.25+, Ninja, a C11 compiler, Python with Capstone, SDL3, FFmpeg, system libcurl and ds-decomp 0.12.1. Follow the region-specific extraction and build instructions with your own original.
